messages:
Jordan: hey @Maya @Kai — I pushed updates to PR #2147, addressed the requested changes and split the behavioral test into its own commit. PTAL when you have a minute. diff: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/2147
Maya: quick skim — looks mostly clean. one nit: test name should include 'kv-rotation' to be consistent with suite. i'll leave an inline comment.
Jordan: thanks, fixed the name and force-pushed. command used: `git commit --amend -m "test(kv): rename rotation test" && git push --force`
Kai: ptal — I ran the canary flow locally for a couple runs. no perf regressions observed, but I left a question about the fallback ordering in runtime/router.go.
Jordan: answered that question in a new comment and added a tiny unit test to cover the branch. CI unit/lint are green locally; canary e2e is intermittently failing in CI right now.
dev-bot: CI report — unit: passed, lint: passed, canary-e2e: failed (flake: timeout in start-runtime step). Retrigger queued.
Priya: I'm OOO this afternoon but will check tomorrow morning. If this needs to merge earlier, we need one more approver — @Maya can you approve after the nit?
Maya: yep, I'll approve once the inline nit is resolved. PTAL @Kai for the fallback comment follow-up.
Kai: left a 1-line suggestion, nothing blocking. will approve once e2e is stable. pulled a quick :eyes: on the test changes.
Jordan: re-ran the failing scenario locally (10 iterations) and didn't hit the timeout. pushed a retry commit to trigger CI: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/2147/commits/3
dev-bot: CI — branch pr/2147: unit ✅, lint ✅, canary-e2e retriggered (1/3).
Maya: approved. :white_check_mark:
Kai: approved. :thumbsup:
Jordan: awesome, thanks team — scheduling merge at 15:30 PT unless anyone objects. If the e2e flakes again, I'll hold off and investigate further.
Priya: sounds good, thanks for the heads-up.
Jordan: noted, will post back after merge or if I hit more flakes.
